title: Manīṣāpañcakam
subtitle: Five convictions on consciousness and non-duality

source.edition: The Works of Sri Sankaracharya, vol. 16, Sri Vani Vilas Press, 1910
source.digitalText: Ambuda CC0 1.0; machine-readable text credit: Arun Prasad

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुषुप्तिषु स्फुटतरा या संविदुज्जृम्भते
या ब्रह्मादिपिपीलिकान्ततनुषु प्रोता जगत्साक्षिणी ।
सैवाहं न च दृश्यवस्त्विति दृढप्रज्ञापि यस्यास्ति चेच्चाण्डालोऽस्तु स तु द्विजोऽस्तु गुरुरित्येषा मनीषा मम ॥
units.translation: The consciousness that shines most clearly in waking, dream, and deep sleep, and is woven through bodies from Brahmā down to the tiniest ant as the witness of the world: whoever is firmly convinced, “I am that very consciousness, and not an object that is seen,” whether an outcaste or a twice-born person, is my teacher. This is my conviction.
units.iast:
jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu sphuṭatarā yā saṃvidujjṛmbhate
yā brahmādipipīlikāntatanuṣu protā jagatsākṣiṇī |
saivāhaṃ na ca dṛśyavastviti dṛḍhaprajñāpi yasyāsti ceccāṇḍālo’stu sa tu dvijo’stu gururityeṣā manīṣā mama ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
ब्रह्मैवाहमिदं जगच्च सकलं चिन्मात्रविस्तारितं
सर्वं चैतदविद्यया त्रिगुणयाऽशेषं मया कल्पितम् ।
इत्थं यस्य दृढा मतिः सुखतरे नित्ये परे निर्मले
चाण्डालोऽस्तु स तु द्विजोऽस्तु गुरुरित्येषा मनीषा मम ॥
units.translation: “I alone am Brahman; this whole world is spread out by consciousness alone. Through ignorance made of three qualities, all this is imagined by me, without remainder.” Whoever has this firm understanding of the blissful, eternal, supreme, stainless reality is my teacher, whether an outcaste or a twice-born person. This is my conviction.
units.iast:
brahmaivāhamidaṃ jagacca sakalaṃ cinmātravistāritaṃ
sarvaṃ caitadavidyayā triguṇayā’śeṣaṃ mayā kalpitam |
itthaṃ yasya dṛḍhā matiḥ sukhatare nitye pare nirmale
cāṇḍālo’stu sa tu dvijo’stu gururityeṣā manīṣā mama ||

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
शश्वन्नश्वरमेव विश्वमखिलं निश्चित्य वाचा गुरोर्नित्यं ब्रह्म निरन्तरं विमृशता निर्व्याजशान्तात्मना ।
भूतं भावि च दुष्कृतं प्रदहता संविन्मये पावके
प्रारब्धाय समर्पितं स्ववपुरित्येषा मनीषा मम ॥
units.translation: Having determined from the teacher’s words that the whole world is indeed ever-perishing, and continually reflecting on Brahman with a guileless, peaceful mind; burning past and future misdeeds in the fire that is consciousness; and offering one’s own body to prārabdha karma, the results already set in motion—this is my conviction.

gloss.en: by the words • of the teacher
to prārabdha, karma already set in motion

units.iast:
śaśvannaśvarameva viśvamakhilaṃ niścitya vācā gurornityaṃ brahma nirantaraṃ vimṛśatā nirvyājaśāntātmanā |
bhūtaṃ bhāvi ca duṣkṛtaṃ pradahatā saṃvinmaye pāvake
prārabdhāya samarpitaṃ svavapurityeṣā manīṣā mama ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
या तिर्यङ्नरदेवताभिरहमित्यन्तः स्फुटा गृह्यते
यद्भासा हृदयाक्षदेहविषया भान्ति स्वतोऽचेतनाः ।
तां भास्यैः पिहितार्कमण्डलनिभां स्फूर्तिं सदा भावयन्
योगी निर्वृतमानसो हि गुरुरित्येषा मनीषा मम ॥
units.translation: The awareness that animals, humans, and gods clearly recognize within as “I”—by whose light the mind, senses, body, and objects shine, though they are insentient in themselves—resembles the sun’s orb hidden by the very things it illumines. The yogi who continually contemplates that awareness with a tranquil mind is indeed a teacher. This is my conviction.
units.iast:
yā tiryaṅnaradevatābhirahamityantaḥ sphuṭā gṛhyate
yadbhāsā hṛdayākṣadehaviṣayā bhānti svato’cetanāḥ |
tāṃ bhāsyaiḥ pihitārkamaṇḍalanibhāṃ sphūrtiṃ sadā bhāvayan
yogī nirvṛtamānaso hi gururityeṣā manīṣā mama ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
यत्सौख्याम्बुधिलेशलेशत इमे शक्रादयो निर्वृता
यच्चित्ते नितरां प्रशान्तकलने लब्ध्वा मुनिर्निर्वृतः ।
यस्मिन्नित्यसुखाम्बुधौ गलितधीर्ब्रह्मैव न ब्रह्मविद्
यः कश्चित्स सुरेन्द्रवन्दितपदो नूनं मनीषा मम ॥
units.translation: The ocean of bliss of such a one fulfills Indra and the others with even a tiny fraction. A sage becomes content on attaining that [bliss] in a deeply tranquil mind. In that eternal ocean of bliss the intellect dissolves. That person is Brahman itself, not merely a knower of Brahman, and Indra bows to their feet. Such is surely my conviction.

gloss.en: in a state of profound quiet
in the eternal ocean of bliss
whose feet are bowed to by Indra

units.iast:
yatsaukhyāmbudhileśaleśata ime śakrādayo nirvṛtā
yaccitte nitarāṃ praśāntakalane labdhvā munirnirvṛtaḥ |
yasminnityasukhāmbudhau galitadhīrbrahmaiva na brahmavid
yaḥ kaścit sa surendravanditapado nūnaṃ manīṣā mama ||

units.label: Colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ मनीषापञ्चकं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus the Manīṣāpañcakam is complete: it was composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, supreme renunciant and teacher among wandering ascetics, disciple of the worship-worthy feet of Govinda Bhagavat.

gloss.en: of the teacher among wandering ascetics
whose feet are worthy of worship
the five verses of firm conviction

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau manīṣāpañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
